help.tips[0].examples[0].en: I applied for a post as an accountant and was invited to an interview.
help.tips[0].examples[1].en: The company is hiring three new staff in the autumn.
help.tips[0].check.whyEn: sich um eine Stelle bewerben = to apply for a job; the Perfekt is hat sich … beworben. einstellen is what the company does (to hire).
help.tips[0].en.text: eine Stelle suchen / finden · sich um eine Stelle bewerben · die Bewerbung schicken · der Lebenslauf · das Vorstellungsgespräch · die Stellenanzeige (job ad) · einstellen (to hire).
help.tips[0].en.title: Finding a job
help.tips[1].examples[0].en: She works part-time but often does overtime.
help.tips[1].examples[1].en: I earn 3,000 euros a month gross, about 2,000 net.
help.tips[1].check.whyEn: Rent for a flat is die Miete. die Rente is the pension and das Gehalt is the salary you earn.
help.tips[1].en.text: der Arbeitsvertrag · das Gehalt (monthly salary) / der Lohn (wage) · brutto / netto · Vollzeit / Teilzeit · Überstunden machen · der Urlaub (30 Tage) · kündigen (to hand in your notice — or, said of the employer, to dismiss someone: Die Firma hat ihm gekündigt).
help.tips[1].en.title: The contract and the money
help.tips[1].en.trap: das Gehalt is the salary; die Rente is the pension (not 'rent', which is die Miete). der Chef is the boss, not a cook (der Koch). Der Termin is an appointment, not a term.
help.tips[2].examples[0].en: After the meeting I finish for the day.
help.tips[2].examples[1].en: My colleague is working from home today.
help.tips[2].check.whyEn: das Homeoffice is the German word for working from home, not a company's main office.
help.tips[2].en.text: der Kollege / die Kollegin · der Chef / die Vorgesetzte · der Angestellte (employee) · der Mitarbeiter (staff member) · die Besprechung / das Meeting · der Feierabend · die Pause · das Homeoffice.
help.tips[2].en.title: People and the working day
help.tips[3].examples[0].en: Have a nice evening (after work)! – Thanks, you too.
help.tips[3].examples[1].en: When are you finishing work today? – At half past five.
help.tips[3].check.whyEn: Schönen Feierabend wishes you a nice evening after work; gleichfalls returns the wish (you too).
help.tips[3].en.text: Feier (celebration) + Abend: the end of the working day is a small party. 'Schönen Feierabend!' is what colleagues say at five.
help.tips[3].en.title: Feierabend — the evening you celebrate
help.context.en: I've been unemployed for three months, but yesterday I had an interview at a small company. The job is part-time, the salary isn't high, but the colleagues seem nice and the boss said I won't have to do overtime. Today I'm sending my CV again by e-mail – and then I'll wait for the contract.
help.mistakes[1].whyEn: sich bewerben um is the verb.
help.mistakes[3].whyEn: kündigen takes the dative of the person: jemandem kündigen. Ich habe gekündigt = I quit.
help.hookEn: Job ads, contracts, colleagues and Feierabend: the words you need to talk about work, and to land your next job.
help.introEn: Arbeit und Beruf is the theme that reaches into every corner of adult life: a job ad you read, a colleague's voicemail, a formal e-mail to an employer, a discussion about work–life balance over lunch. The vocabulary sits in four groups. Finding a job: die Stelle (post), die Bewerbung (application), der Lebenslauf (CV), das Vorstellungsgespräch (interview), die Firma / das Unternehmen. The contract: der Vertrag, das Gehalt (salary), die Teilzeit / Vollzeit, die Überstunden (overtime), der Urlaub, die Kündigung (notice, from either side). The people: der Chef / die Chefin, der Kollege / die Kollegin, der Angestellte, der Mitarbeiter. The day: die Besprechung (meeting), der Termin, der Feierabend (end of the working day), die Rente (retirement). And the two states: berufstätig, arbeitslos. Several are false friends, marked in the tips.
help.rememberEn[0]: Stelle → Bewerbung → Lebenslauf → Vorstellungsgespräch → Vertrag: the road to a job.
help.rememberEn[1]: Gehalt = salary, Rente = pension, Miete = rent.
sentences[0].whyEn: die Stelle is the specific position; die Arbeit is work in general.
sentences[1].whyEn: der Chef — the French loanword for the boss.
sentences[2].whyEn: sich bewerben → die Bewerbung: -ung forms a noun, always feminine.
sentences[3].whyEn: das Gehalt — the monthly salary; der Lohn is more for hourly wages.
sentences[4].whyEn: in Rente gehen — the fixed phrase; civil servants go 'in Pension'.
sentences[5].whyEn: der Termin — any fixed appointment with a time, work or private.
sentences[6].whyEn: der Kollege → die Kollegen: the -n plural of weak nouns.
sentences[7].whyEn: der Lebenslauf — literally the 'run of life', the CV.
sentences[8].whyEn: besprechen → die Besprechung — the -ung pattern again.
sentences[10].whyEn: der Vertrag — the contract; unterschreiben is to sign (write beneath).
sentences[11].whyEn: die Überstunden — hours OVER the normal working time, almost always plural.
sentences[12].whyEn: Teilzeit — a PART of full time; the opposite is Vollzeit.
sentences[13].whyEn: Feierabend machen — the lovely German word for clocking off.
sentences[14].whyEn: die Firma — the company; an Italian loanword, plural Firmen.
sentences[15].whyEn: Gehalt + s + Erhöhung = die Gehaltserhöhung — the linking s joins the compound.
sentences[16].whyEn: der Arbeitsvertrag — Arbeit + linking s + Vertrag; im = in dem.
sentences[17].whyEn: das Vorstellungsgespräch — you introduce yourself (sich vorstellen), hence the name.
